contentItem.title: 性质与证明：中项无理线段与线段
contentItem.englishTitle: A first bimedial straight line is divided at one point only.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A first bimedial straight line is divided at one point only.
头双中项无理线段直线只分为一个点。（相关点与线段：A）

Let AB be a first bimedial straight line divided at C, so that AC, CB are medial straight lines commensurable in square only and containing a rational rectangle; I say that AB is not so divided at another point.
让我们把AB变成第一个双中项无理线段直线,分为C,这样AC,CB是中项无理线段,包含有理矩形;我说,AB不是在另一个时候这样分割的；上述对应量可公度。
For, if possible, let it be divided at D also, so that AD, DB are also medial straight lines commensurable in square only and containing a rational rectangle.
如果可能的话,也让它分为D,AD,DB也是中项无理线段,平方可公度而长度不可公度,包含有理,矩形。

Since, then, that by which twice the rectangle AD, DB differs from twice the rectangle AC, CB is that by which the squares on AC, CB differ from the squares on AD, DB, while twice the rectangle AD, DB differs from twice the rectangle AC, CB by a rational area—for both are rational— therefore the squares on AC, CB also differ from the squares on AD, DB by a rational area, though they are medial: which is absurd. [[x. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26) ]
自此,矩形 AD和DB的两倍与矩形 AC和CB的两倍是AC和AC的正方形和DB的两倍,而正方形和AD和DB的两倍是矩形和AD的两倍,CB和有理面积的两倍是有理,因此,AC和CB的正方形和CB也与AD和有理面积的正方形和中项无理线段不同,尽管它们都是中项无理线段,这是荒谬的 [ [x. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)
Therefore a first bimedial straight line is not divided into its terms at different points; therefore it is so divided at one point only.
因此,头双中项无理线段直线没有在不同点按其条件划分,因此只在一个点如此划分。
